brief: Two bases side by side joined with side connectors, each with a bin.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full are adjacent at level 0.

connector:0#0,0|1,0 installed on the wall between the two bases (side-connector-double offered at edge 0,0|1,0). check_build lists the two cells as separate groups, consistent with a side connector joining them.
capOpenFaces added end caps and lockJoints applied; check_build ok with meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Two full bases side by side at level 0 (0,0 and 1,0), joined on their shared wall by a double side connector, each fitted with a full-depth bin (hex-bin-full). Open faces capped and joints locked; check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: Side connector is on. Now I'll find the bin sockets for both bases.
Both bins are in and the caps and joint locks are applied. I'll run the configurator check before finishing.
